title: JDFX Bundle Manifest
description: Schema for the manifest.json file inside a .jdfx zip bundle. The bundle also contains document.json (validated against jdf-schema.json) and an assets/ directory of binary blobs referenced by element `resource` fields.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Bumped when the manifest shape itself changes — independent of the JDF document format version inside document.json.

generator.description: App name + version that wrote this bundle, e.g. "JDF Reader 0.1.14".

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by element `resource` fields in document.json.

path.description: Path inside the zip, always under assets/.

size.description: Uncompressed byte size of the asset.
